---
title: "Section"
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['#quarto-sidebar a.sidebar-link.active[href="./section.html"][aria-current="page"]']
        - ['#quarto-sidebar a.sidebar-link:not(.active)[aria-current]']
---

A section with its own page gets `aria-current="page"` on its link when it is
the current page.
